fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-d272dcf4 at a1a714e0 (attempt 3, after review quality f1): go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestWatchdogCIRerun -v -count=1 PASS. Its fake gh shows the failed run 7 rerun once on a red head, nothing while the rerun runs, one resume with --retry after green and none on the next poll, no second rerun and no resume when the same head goes red again after the rerun (CIDone set), no rerun of a head whose run is already at attempt 2, and a rerun for a new head. TestWatchdogCIReadsBounded (via watchdogPasses) shows each run's PR read at most once per poll across the three PR passes: over three polls, gone-PR and red-after-rerun runs are read once, a run with its budget spent is never read, and a run is read again once its journal moves on. go test -run Watchdog ./internal/api, go test ./internal/daemon/... and go vet ./internal/api all pass. In the diff of 47741152, watchdogReadOnce wraps d.ci per poll; watchdogPRIdle skips runs while the journal end equals PRGone or CIDone, or when the budget is spent; rerunSpent replaces the old Attempts loop with the same meaning. Trade-off noted, as the f1 finding asked: while CIDone holds, a head pushed by hand without a resume is not read until the journal moves on.
